new_text: When the system is disabled due to insufficient engagement by the driver, the system shall only be re-enabled after the driver has confirmed by a deliberate action their understanding of their responsibilities and appropriate use of the system.
note: Obligation changed from requesting driver to read info material at powertrain deactivation to gating re-enable on deliberate confirmation. Clear meaning change.

new_text: When the system deviates from the lane-change assessment at speeds up to 60 km/h, the manufacturer shall explain to the Type Approval Authority the distances and timings for an approaching vehicle under which a lane change manoeuvre can be started, and provide evidence of those situations being deemed controllable for other road users.
note: New sentence with a clear manufacturer obligation; builder may emit as one or two requirements (explain / evidence). Our flags split into two; either way matches.

new_text: At speeds up to 60 km/h the system may deviate from the assessment of the approaching vehicle's deceleration.
note: Permissive 'may' clause; builder might fold into the explain requirement rather than keep standalone.

new_text: When there is an approaching vehicle, the DCAS shall be designed to not make an approaching vehicle decelerate at a higher level than 3.0 m/s2 ... (except at speeds up to 60 km/h where deviation is allowed).
note: Text of old sentences unchanged; only possible if builder bakes the exception into R-089. Our modified flag is likely a false positive.
Text unchanged; likely false positive in our flags.
Text unchanged; likely false positive in our flags.

new_text: The provisions of paragraphs 6.3.2. to 6.3.8. shall equally apply when going straight across an intersection for systems capable of performing a system-initiated left or right turn at that intersection.
note: New normative sentence; heading 6.4 itself would be skipped.

new_text: In non-highway environments, the system shall only make the vehicle automatically accelerate from standstill if the driver is not deemed to be visually disengaged as per paragraph 5.5.4.2.5. for more than 2 seconds immediately prior to the drive off.
note: List item (a) split with lead-in. Builder may instead keep (a)+(b) in one requirement.

new_text: In non-highway environments, the system shall only make the vehicle automatically accelerate from standstill if the system has confirmed there is no risk of collision detected along the drive-off path.
The information reported to the Type Approval Authority is not intended to be shared publicly.

new_text: The manufacturer shall state whether the system continues to provide lateral control assistance where the lane is demarked by something other than a lane marking (parked cars, curb, construction infrastructure) in non-highway operation.
note: Table-row addition in an annex-like information document; builder produced no requirements for this paragraph in old version, so unlikely.
